summary: The implementation includes a public anonymous checklist with local storage, backend submission, and an admin dashboard with local authentication. However, Internet Identity authentication (as specified) is replaced with local browser-based authentication, and the exact 7-section structure with specific item counts from REQ-1 is not fully verifiable from the truncated diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Create an admin dashboard accessible only through Internet Identity authentication
missing_requirements.reason: The implementation uses local browser-based authentication (useLocalAuth with Ed25519 identities stored in localStorage) instead of Internet Identity. AdminLoginPage.tsx and useLocalAuth.tsx show a display-name-based login system rather than Internet Identity integration.

missing_requirements.requirement: Create 7 sections with specific item counts: Documents & Cab (18 items), Engine Compartment (9 items), Tires & Wheels (6 items), Brakes & Suspension (6 items), Lights & Electrical (7 items), Box/Cargo Area (7 items), Safety & Emergency (5 items), Final Walk-Around (5 items), Driver Acknowledgment (2 items)
missing_requirements.reason: PublicChecklistPage.tsx is truncated before showing all sections. Only 5 sections are visible (Documents & Cab with 14 items, Engine Compartment with 8 items, Tires & Wheels with 6 items, Brakes & Suspension with 6 items, Lights & Electrical truncated). Cannot verify Final Walk-Around, full Safety & Emergency, full Box/Cargo Area, or Driver Acknowledgment sections, and item counts do not match for visible sections.

hallucinated_features.description: Local browser-based authentication system with Ed25519 identity generation and display name registration
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest explicitly requires Internet Identity for admin authentication only. The implementation introduces a custom local authentication system that stores credentials in localStorage and uses display names, which was not requested and contradicts the Internet Identity requirement.

hallucinated_features.description: User registration system with registerUser backend method and user profiles
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest non-goals explicitly state 'User accounts or profiles for drivers completing checklists' should not be implemented. The backend includes registerUser functionality and UserProfile types for all users, not just admins.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin dashboard statistics showing total checklists and unique drivers
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-6 specifies displaying submissions in a table/list with timestamps and completion status, but does not request dashboard statistics cards or aggregate metrics.
